response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signals
  FROM signals
)
SELECT tc.telescref,
       tc.signal_count,
       CAST(tc.signal_count AS REAL) / total.total_signals AS signal_share
FROM telescope_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY signal_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share means each telescope's signal count divided by the total number of rows in signals; telescopes with no detected signals are excluded because they have no signals.telescref value to group by.
